name: new_bank_v2_grabmyo_feature_space_personal_anchor
dataset: official checksum-verified GRABMyo eight forearm EMG channels, 2048 Hz, 20 disjoint 250 ms windows per five-second recording
calibration_repetitions: for budget N use native repetitions 1..N of every class for the same subject and day
feature_fit: F0 Rest thresholds and all feature-family metadata fit only on Day1. Each family uses mean and standard deviation across twenty 250 ms windows per native recording.
source_classifier: Day1 StandardScaler and unweighted LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924; replay all 448 target source probabilities to <=1e-10
feature_anchor: Transform all trial features by the Day1-fitted StandardScaler for the corresponding arm. For each target gesture, mean its allowed calibration trial vectors. Squared Euclidean distance per feature dimension to each prototype; softmax negative distances divided by the median positive pairwise squared prototype distance per dimension, with floor 1e-12. Mix 0.5 source classifier probability plus 0.5 feature-anchor probability. N=0 exactly uses source classifier probability.
selection: fixed budget/weight/metric rule for every arm and phase; no final-based tuning, no classifier retraining on target labels
scope: public same-user cross-day feature-space prototype adaptation; not personal raw-channel normalization, not F8 session signature, not own-device live recognition
boundary: Days 2 and 3 have previously been examined; Day3 descriptive. Calibration recordings 1..N and evaluation recordings 6,7 must be disjoint. One fixed class taxonomy, eight selected users.
